---
title: "setupmjr"
toc: true
---

`setupmjr` is a cross-platform setup utility.

## Commands

```bash
setupmjr - Cross-platform setup utility
Commands:
  hpc       Master HPC setup
  hpc scratch [--r]
  hpc apptainer
  hpc slurm
  hpc login git
  hpc git
  hpc r
  shell <shell> rc.d
  shell <shell> path
  shell <shell> login
  r radian
  git
  git user
  git login
  git login text
  git login cache
  git login mngr
  repo readme
  repo devcontainer [--repo <owner/repo>] [--branch <branch>] [--no-prebuild]
  repo action <action-name>
  repo install repos
```
